Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Defines tagged object identities and index in the displayed representation. n is locally quantified over natural numbers; it is not an unlinked object identifier or future semantic concept. obj(n), index and the Nat domain are defined here; α and β are explicitly introduced as object identities.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
